```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Load libraries
```{r}
library(dbplyr)
library(dplyr)
library(tximport)
library(biomaRt)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
```

----------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Read in metadata
----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
metadata <- read.table("../meta/metadata.txt", header = TRUE)
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample
metadata
```

----------------------------------------------------------------------
2. Locate tsv files & read in abundancies & convert to gene counts
- Info: tximport tsv kallisto [https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/tximport/inst/doc/tximport.html#kallisto)]
- tx2gene.GRCh38.cdna.csv generated with make_tx2gene_from_reference.sh
----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
# Locate abundance files
kallisto_path <- "../data/kallisto_out/"
files <- paste(kallisto_path, list.files(path=kallisto_path, pattern="abundance.tsv", recursive = TRUE), sep = "/")
names(files) <- metadata$sample

# Assign transcripts to genes
tx2gene <- read.csv("../reference/tx2gene.GRCh38.cdna.csv", header=TRUE)

# Add names of addon transcripts used in kallisto reference
addons <- list('hP2X3_addon','GPR75_addon','GIPR_addon')
addons_df <- data.frame(unlist(addons), unlist(addons))
names(addons_df) = c("TXNAME","GENEID")

tx2gene = rbind(tx2gene, addons_df)

# Convert to gene counts using tx2gene table
txi.kallisto.tsv <- tximport(files, countsFromAbundance='no', type = "kallisto", tx2gene = tx2gene, ignoreAfterBar = TRUE)
head(txi.kallisto.tsv$counts)
dim(txi.kallisto.tsv$counts)

write.csv(txi.kallisto.tsv, "../results/DE/txi.kallisto_UNFILTERED.csv")
```


----------------------------------------------------------------------
3. Filter low abundancies
- Filter transcripts with TPM 0 accross all samples
- Filter count matrix (`txi.kallisto.tsv$counts`) using TPM info (`txi.kallisto.tsv$abundance`)
----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# Exclude transcripts from count matrix (txi.kallisto.tsv$counts), with TPM 0 accross all samples (TPMs in txi.kallisto.tsv$abundance)
tpms_filtered <- txi.kallisto.tsv$abundance[rowSums(txi.kallisto.tsv$abundance[,0:ncol(txi.kallisto.tsv$abundance)]>0)>0, ]
count_matrix <- as.data.frame(txi.kallisto.tsv$counts[rownames(tpms_filtered),])

# Extract round count matrix Kallisto takes discrete values & remove gene version numbers
count_matrix <- round(count_matrix)
rownames(count_matrix) <- gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", as.character(rownames(count_matrix)))

# Number genes filtered out (counts stored in txi.kallisto.tsv$counts)
dim(txi.kallisto.tsv$counts)
dim(count_matrix)

# Print log2(count + 1) transformed counts (log2(n+1) used to visualize counts)
pdf(file="../results/DE/boxplot_raw_counts.pdf", width = 10, height = 4)
boxplot(log2(as.matrix(txi.kallisto.tsv$counts)+1),ylab=expression('Log'[2]~'Read counts'),las=2,main="Unfiltered data (log2(count + 1))", cex.axis=0.8)
dev.off()

pdf(file="../results/DE/boxplot_filtered_counts.pdf", width = 10, height = 4)
boxplot(log2(as.matrix(count_matrix)+1),ylab=expression('Log'[2]~'Read counts'),las=2,main="Filtered data (log2(count + 1))", cex.axis=0.8)
dev.off()
```


----------------------------------------------------------------------
4. Convert gene IDs into gene symbols
----------------------------------------------------------------------

4.1 Get ensembl df, take gene id and gene symbols
- Use https://may2024.archive.ensembl.org/index.html - release 112 (same release 112 used as Kallisto ref & to make tx2gene)
```{r}
# Get ensembl df, take gene id and gene symbols
ensembl = useMart("ensembl", host="https://may2024.archive.ensembl.org", dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
```

4.2 For count matrix
```{r}
CM <- as.matrix(count_matrix)
dim(CM)

# Retrieve Ensembl gene IDs and gene names
ensembl_df <- biomaRt::getBM(attributes=c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name"), values=rownames(CM), mart=ensembl)

# Append addons to ensembl df
addons <- list('hP2X3_addon','GPR75_addon','GIPR_addon')
addons_df <- data.frame(unlist(addons), unlist(addons))
names(addons_df) = c("ensembl_gene_id","external_gene_name")
ensembl_df = rbind(ensembl_df, addons_df)

# Keep symbols present in count matrix & add gene symbols to CM
my_genes_ann = ensembl_df[match(rownames(CM), ensembl_df$ensembl_gene_id),]
rownames(CM) <- my_genes_ann$external_gene_name

# Remove NA & "" rows
CM <-  CM[!is.na(rownames(CM)) & rownames(CM) != "", ]
group <- rownames(CM)
CM <- rowsum(CM, group) # Sum rows with same gene symbols

write.csv(CM, "../results/DE/count_matrix.csv", row.names = TRUE)
dim(CM)
```

4.3 For TPMs
- Filter and convert to gene symbols
```{r}
# ZEROs FILTER - only exlcude rows with no observed abundance across all columns:
tpms_filtered <- txi.kallisto.tsv$abundance[rowSums(txi.kallisto.tsv$abundance[,0:ncol(txi.kallisto.tsv$abundance)]>0)> 0, ]
dim(tpms_filtered)

# Filter tpms and convert to gene symbols
rownames(tpms_filtered) <- gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", as.character(rownames(tpms_filtered)))
tpms_filtered <- as.matrix(tpms_filtered)

# Keep symbols present in count matrix & add gene symbols to tpms_filtered
my_genes_ann = ensembl_df[match(rownames(tpms_filtered), ensembl_df$ensembl_gene_id),]
rownames(tpms_filtered) <- my_genes_ann$external_gene_name

# Remove NA & "" rows
tpms_filtered <-  tpms_filtered[!is.na(rownames(tpms_filtered)) & rownames(tpms_filtered) != "", ]
group <- rownames(tpms_filtered)
tpms_filtered <- rowsum(tpms_filtered, group) # Sum rows with same gene symbols

write.csv(tpms_filtered, "../results/DE/tpms.csv")
dim(tpms_filtered)
```


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. DESEQ2 -Differential gene expression analysis
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

5.1 Ensure rownames in metadata (samples) == colnames of count_matrix 
- Convert to factor first
```{r}
colnames <- names(metadata)
metadata[,colnames] <- lapply(metadata[,colnames], factor)

all(rownames(metadata) == colnames(CM))
is.matrix(CM)
```

5.2 Run deseq2, design formula: ~short_name
```{r}
# Create DESeqDataSet object
dds_object <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(CM, metadata, ~ short_name) 

# Run deseq2
dds <- DESeq(dds_object)
```

5.3 Save normalized and transformed counts
- vst normalized counts (blind = FALSE) -> when plotting PCA (https://lashlock.github.io/compbio/R_presentation.html & https://support.bioconductor.org/p/9148734/)
- estimateSizeFactors transformed counts (https://hbctraining.github.io/DGE_workshop/lessons/02_DGE_count_normalization.html)
```{r}
# Extract the vst normalized counts blind=TRUE
vsd_blind <- vst(dds_object, blind = TRUE)
vsd <- vst(dds_object, blind = FALSE)

# Save vst files (normalization for visualization, not used by deseq2)
write.csv(assay(vsd_blind), "../results/DE/vst_blind_true.csv")
write.csv(assay(vsd), "../results/DE/vst_blind_false.csv")

# Get and save estimateSizeFactors normalized counts 
estFactors <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_object)
normalized_counts <- counts(estFactors, normalized=TRUE)
write.csv(normalized_counts, file="../results/DE/estFactors_normalized_counts.csv")
```


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. Some dendrogram & PCA plotting
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

6.1 Plot vsd normalized counts in cluster dendrogram 
```{r}
vsd_tree <- assay(vsd) %>% t()
htree <- hclust(dist(vsd_tree), method = "average")

pdf(file="../results/DE/htree.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)
plot(htree)
dev.off()
```

6.2 PCA - of vsd normalized counts
```{r}
pdf(file="../results/DE/PCA_custom.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)

pcaData <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("cell_type", "case"), ntop = 500, returnData = TRUE)

pcaData$cell_type <- as.factor(pcaData$cell_type)
pcaData$case <- as.factor(pcaData$case)

ggplot(pcaData, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = cell_type, shape = case)) +
  geom_point(size = 5,stroke = 0.6) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1: ", round(attr(pcaData, "percentVar")[1] * 100, 1), "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", round(attr(pcaData, "percentVar")[2] * 100, 1), "% variance"),
    color = "Cell type",
    shape = "Transiently exp."
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 23, 4)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        aspect.ratio = 1)

dev.off()
```

6.3 PCA - of vsd normalized counts without addons
```{r}
# DESeqDataSet object
CM_nad <- CM[!rownames(CM) %in% c('hP2X3_addon','GPR75_addon','GIPR_addon'), ]
dds_object_nad <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(CM_nad, metadata, ~ short_name) 

vsd_nad <- vst(dds_object_nad, blind = FALSE)

pdf(file="../results/DE/PCA_no_addons.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)
plotPCA(vsd_nad, intgroup = c("short_name"), ntop = 500) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(color = "Sample group") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        aspect.ratio=1/1) +
  geom_point(shape=1, size=1.5)
dev.off()
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. Exract contrasts
- Volcano plots of contrasts, save DE .csv, upset plotsa of overlaps
- Save pairwise contrasts, save DEGs for each pairwise contrast

Here - contrast c("short_name", "Vulko", "Expi"))
  Positive log2FC -> UP in vulko
  Negative log2FC -> DOWN in vulko
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r fig.height=9}
# Contrasts of interest
GPR75 <- c("Expi_GPR75", "Vulko_GPR75")
GIPR <- c("Expi_GIPR", "Vulko_GIPR")
hP2X3 <- c("Expi_hP2X3", "Vulko_hP2X3")

combinations <- list(GPR75, GIPR, hP2X3)

DEGs_dfs <- list()
DEGs_list <- list()

for (comb in combinations) {
  
  j <- comb[1]
  i <- comb[2]
  
  # Names
  contrast_name <- paste(i, "_vs_", j, sep = "")

  # Contrast conditions and save contrasts
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("short_name", i, j), cooksCutoff = FALSE)
  write.csv(res, file.path(paste("../results/DE/contrasts/contrast_", i, "_vs_", j, ".csv", sep = '')))
  res_df <- data.frame(res)
  
  # Get DEGs df and list
  res_degs_df <- res_df[res_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 1,]
  res_degs_df[res_degs_df == ""] <- NA
  res_degs_df <- na.omit(res_degs_df)
  
  res_degs_list <- as.character(row.names(res_degs_df))
  
  # Save DEGs df and list
  DEGs_dfs[[contrast_name]] <- res_degs_df  
  DEGs_list[[contrast_name]] <- res_degs_list  
  
  # Save DEG dfs of degs
  write.csv(res_degs_df, file.path(paste("../results/DE/contrasts/DEGs_", i, "_vs_", j, ".csv", sep = '')))
  
  # Write tsv
  write.table(res_degs_df, file=file.path(paste("../results/DE/contrasts/DEGs_", i, "_vs_", j, "_TSV.tsv", sep = '')),
              quote=FALSE, sep='\t', col.names = NA)
  
  # Volcanos
  pdf(file=paste("../results/DE/volcanos/",contrast_name,".pdf", sep=""), width = 12, height = 10)
  plot(EnhancedVolcano(res_df, lab = row.names(res_df),
                       x = 'log2FoldChange',
                       y = 'padj',
                       labSize = 4,
                       title = paste(i, "vs.", j)))
  dev.off()
}

```


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. DESEQ2 - all producers vs non-producers
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
metadata_ALL <- metadata %>% dplyr::filter(case != "wt")
CM_ALL <- CM[, !(colnames(CM) %in% c("Expi_wt_S20", "Vulko_wt_S19"))]

# Convert to factors
colnames <- names(metadata_ALL)
metadata_ALL[,colnames] <- lapply(metadata_ALL[,colnames], factor)

# Ensure rownames in metadata (samples) == colnames of count_matrix 
all(rownames(metadata_ALL) == colnames(CM_ALL))
is.matrix(CM_ALL)
```


```{r}
dds_object_ALL <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(CM_ALL, metadata_ALL, ~ cell_type) 
dds_pair_ALL <- DESeq(dds_object_ALL)
```

# CONTRAST INFO: c("condition", "treatment", "control"))
  Here: c("cell_type", "Vulko", "Expi")
  # Positive log2FC -> UP in Vulko vs Expi
  # Negative log2FC -> DOWN in Vulko vs Expi
  
```{r}
# Save contrasts
res_ALL <- results(dds_pair_ALL, contrast = c("cell_type", "Vulko", "Expi"), cooksCutoff = FALSE)
write.csv(res_ALL, file.path(paste("../results/DE/contrasts/contrast_", "Vulko", "_vs_", "Expi", ".csv", sep = '')))

# Save DEGs
res_df_ALL <- data.frame(res_ALL)
res_df_degs_ALL <- res_df_ALL[res_df_ALL$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df_ALL$log2FoldChange) > 1,]
res_df_degs_ALL[res_df_degs_ALL == ""] <- NA
res_df_degs_ALL <- na.omit(res_df_degs_ALL)
write.csv(res_df_degs_ALL, file.path(paste("../results/DE/contrasts/DEGs_", "Vulko", "_vs_", "Expi", ".csv", sep = '')))
```
